questions.domain: Foundation 11: Marketing, sales and social media
questions.prompt: What is a marketing channel?

choices.text: A television station the business must own itself
A way of reaching customers

A legal filing that registers the brand name

questions.correct_answer: A way of reaching customers
questions.intro: A MARKETING CHANNEL is a way of reaching customers: a social media platform, email, local flyers, a market stall, search, word of mouth, or partnerships with other businesses. Choose a channel by asking: Where do my target customers already spend time? What can I keep doing every week with my time and budget? Can I measure results? Starting with one or two channels done well usually beats a little effort on seven. A channel that works for one business may not work for another.

questions.intro: An old saying goes, "Fish where the fish are." A fancy rod is useless in an empty pond. Marketing channels work the same way: the best channel is where your particular customers already gather, not the newest or most famous one. And just as a person can only watch so many fishing lines, an owner can only keep up a few channels well.
